gloss: to assemble, to form, to cross

definitions.explanation: To create a team or group.
To interlock parts of the body.

notes:
{組|く}む is a versatile verb whose core meaning involves interlocking or joining things together. It extends to forming groups and creating structures.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {組|く}まれる (passive)

ASPECT (ている):
{組|く}んでいる describes a resulting state: {腕|うで}を{組|く}んでいる (has arms folded).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- チームを{組|く}む: to form a team
- {腕|うで}を{組|く}む: to fold/cross one's arms
- {脚|あし}を{組|く}む: to cross one's legs
- {予定|よてい}を{組|く}む: to put together a schedule
- {番組|ばんぐみ}を{組|く}む: to arrange a program

COMPOUNDS:
- {組|く}み{合|あ}わせる: to combine
- {組|く}み{立|た}てる: to assemble (a product)
- {番組|ばんぐみ}: TV/radio program
